title: 13 Things Mentally Strong Parents Don’t Do

questions.q: What does lesson 1 say mentally strong parents encourage in their kids?
a: Responsibility and persistence rather than a victim mentality
questions.why: Lesson 1 contrasts responsibility and perseverance with a victim mindset.

questions.q: What was behind Cody's poor grades despite helpful medication?
a: Learned helplessness reinforced by his parents
A workload that was far too heavy
questions.why: The summary says his parents' view of his ADHD made him believe nothing could change.

questions.q: What should parents aim for instead of perfection, per lesson 2?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says to help kids try for excellence rather than perfection.

questions.q: What does helicopter parenting lead to, according to the summary?
a: Kids who can't bounce back from mistakes
questions.why: Over-managing means children don't learn how to recover from errors.

questions.q: How does lesson 3 suggest making family values clear?
a: Write a family mission statement together
Post a list of household rules
questions.why: Lesson 3 suggests a short mission statement with everyone's input.
